skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply theories of organizational change, resistance to change, and change management processes.
Develop skills in organizational learning and building learning organizations.
Analyze and evaluate factors that drive and hinder organizational change.
Effective communication, negotiation, and group management skills in the context of change.
Apply change management processes to solve organizational problems.
Lead and manage change initiatives within organizations.
Manage time effectively in the context of organizational change.
Work effectively in teams and manage group dynamics during change.
Demonstrate independence, responsibility, and continuous learning in professional settings.
Make ethical decisions and demonstrate professional responsibility in change management.
